releaseNotes: business/ — templates/ is renamed for what it actually is: the artifacts a launch produces. ARCHITECTURE.md's audience split says a founder reads business/, an agent reads playbook/, and a maintainer touches machine/; calling the directory templates/ described the file kind rather than the audience, which is the same mistake references/ made. 175 path mentions rewritten across 89 files, plus the audit pipeline root, both package manifests, and the workspace renderer default.

The docs/ and pages/ sub-split inside business/ is deliberately deferred. Moving the eight rendered HTML files into business/pages/ broke artifact-contract starter paths and PROJECT_STATE evidence entries that pin exact filenames, and the churn was disproportionate to the benefit while the rename alone already delivers the audience separation. ARCHITECTURE.md keeps docs/ and pages/ as the target; splitting them is its own change with its own evidence-path migration.

One self-inflicted bug worth recording: a blanket "templates" to "business" replacement hit JSON schema property names, not just paths — workspace.schema.json's templates property became business, so every generated board failed validation with a missing-property error that looked like a renderer bug. Path rewrites have to distinguish a path segment from an identifier; the schema and generated board were restored from HEAD.
